text:
maria_cs: hey team, kicking off onboarding for Galactic Insights. goal: align stakeholders, set 30/60/90 success criteria, surface renewal risks early, and lock enablement dates. bob (customer) is on thread.

sam_ae: quick context: six-month pilot, expansion contingent on performance. key asks: search latency <200ms and high-quality semantic embeddings. renewal signal tied to top-10 hit rate.

bob_gi: thanks! we have a sample dataset and dev access ready. would like an end-of-week demo in week 1. also need to ensure EU data residency for EU users.

jay_ce: i'll take technical onboarding (env, ingest, integration). proposed plan: env validation days 1-2, ingest pipeline day 3-5, demo day 7. need s3 creds + staging access to Redwood Private.

ana_prod: product validation notes: suggest 3 measurable success metrics to map to renewal: 1) 95th-pct latency <=200ms under baseline traffic, 2) top-10 precision >=0.72 on their eval set, 3) inference error rate <=2%. i'll prepare an eval script.

maria_cs: proposed RACI: sam_ae stakeholder lead, maria_cs CS owner, jay_ce tech owner, ana_prod product validation, tom_ops ops/security & data residency.

tom_ops: we have EU Private deployments. i'll confirm KMS/HSM requirements and note potential on-prem lead time (2-3 weeks) as a timeline risk.

maria_cs: draft 30/60/90 milestones: week 1: env validation, sample ingest, demo, enablement #1. weeks 2-4: performance tuning, caching/batching config, quant recommendations, docs handoff. weeks 5-12: scale tests, SLA baseline, ops training, go/no-go.

sam_ae: recommend a formal renewal checkpoint at day 60: meeting to review metrics; hit => expansion conversation, miss => remediation plan.

calendar-bot: created event "Galactic Insights Onboard: Week 1 demo" May 14 10:00-11:00 UTC. attendees: maria_cs, sam_ae, jay_ce, ana_prod, tom_ops, bob_gi.

maria_cs: i'll send a pre-demo checklist (creds, test queries, sample size).

bob_gi: dataset + creds by EOD tomorrow. quick ask: can we get a sandbox showing token-level cost per route? that influences our forecast.

ana_prod: we can surface per-route token metrics in Console. jay, can you create a dashboard card for their top-3 routes?

jay_ce: yes. i'll add dashboard card and demo KV prefix caching for common prompts in week 2 to cut cost and latency.

maria_cs: captured risks: 1) data residency/on-prem lead time (owner: tom_ops), 2) renewal checkpoint at day 60 (owner: sam_ae), 3) customer-limited engineering bandwidth (owner: bob_gi).

actions (owners and due dates):
- tom_ops: confirm EU KMS & lead times (+3 business days)
- jay_ce: env validation checklist + dashboard card (due: pre-demo)
- ana_prod: eval pass/fail script + thresholds (due: day 7)
- sam_ae: draft renewal checkpoint terms & commercial trigger (due: day 45)
- bob_gi: share creds + sample dataset (due: EOD next day)
- maria_cs: assemble success playbook + weekly health template (due: before demo)

maria_cs: i'll post the playbook link here when ready. any pushback on owners/timeline?

sam_ae: fine from AE side, monitoring expansion motion.

bob_gi: all good, thanks for the clarity.

maria_cs: closing thread for now; will reopen if any blockers. :thumbsup:
